p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-cleared goods to the buyer's company.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risks and costs are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance costs of the goods to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers the goods to the destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.

p.espaces.ds_t: o Drop Shipping and Online Sales
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: Find a supplier, set the right price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Drop shipping means a supplier selling a product directly to your customer. Easy to start, but you are responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Select the products that are allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeit, no unauthorized controlled product.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Manufacturer/Supplier" list here or manufacturing platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Estimate the real cost: production, supply, customs taxes, share in the consumer country, payment charges and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activities: business status, GST and taxes according to your country (see Business Regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumers’ rights: clear pricing including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: The supplier who wants payment by bank transfer or in crypto currency is not fully secure.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package coming from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
